title: Geometric Criteria for Global Observability
statement: For an observed smooth dynamical system whose local observability Gramian is uniformly positive definite and bounded, is the system globally observable on [0,T] whenever the Gramian-induced state-space Riemannian manifold is geodesically complete and has uniformly negative curvature?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.
